name: Sajin Komamura
note: No build guide available on hideoutgacha.com at time of authoring. Tier/role/damage type sourced from the tier list.

skills.description:
Komamura slashes an enemy with Tenken 5 times, dealing DMG equal to 468% of ATK. During the 5th basic attack, Tengen Myo-oh attacks alongside Komamura, gaining 1 stack of Build Up. ~~Myo-oh Slash~~ Bankai State 
 Tengen Myo-oh fully manifests and wields a massive blade to perform 2 horizontal slashes on all enemies in front of him, dealing AoE DMG equal to 368% of ATK. Each slash grants 1 stack of Build Up.
skills.name: Roar, Tenken

skills.description:
Komamura releases his Spiritual Power, dealing damage equal to 191.25% of ATK to nearby enemies and knocking them back. He also gains a 15s shield that can absorb damage equal to 30% of his Max HP. The shield persists when switching characters. ~~Coercion~~ Bankai State 
 Kokujo Tengen Myo-oh fully manifests and swings a massive blade to smash enemies in front of him 3 times, dealing DMG equal to 765% of ATK and gaining 2 stacks of Build Up.
skills.name: Intimidation

skills.description:
Komamura releases Bankai, summoning the colossal Kokujo Tengen Myo-oh. All of his attacks become powerful moves performed in unison with Kokujo Tengen Myo-oh, and their Strike DMG is increased by 35% for 20s. 
 While Kokujo Tengen Myo-oh is on the field, Komamura can't release Flash Step or counter, and his HP won't drop below 1.
skills.name: Bankai - Kokujo Tengen Myo-oh

skills.description: Upon a successful counter against the enemy attack, Komamura releases the Spiritual Pressure from his palm, dealing damage equal to 956% of his ATK and knocking the enemy down. During the next 6s, the enemy hit will have their Spiritual Pressure Bar drained at a 30% higher rate when being attacked.
skills.name: Counter

skills.description:
~~While the Battlefield Skill is active, all characters in the team have their Strike DMG increased by 30%~~ 
 
 Komamura's Battlefield Skill button will be activated when any on-field teammate releases a technique or the final strike of their basic attacks. Cooldown: 3.5s. ~~Tenken Ascension - Slash~~ 
 Komamura attacks together with Tengen Myo-oh, slashing the target to deal 180.25% AoE DMG and gaining 1 stack of Build Up. After every 2 releases of Tenken Ascension - Slash, the next Battlefield Skill will become the more powerful Tenken Ascension - Smash. ~~Tenken Ascension - Smash~~ After releasing Tenken Ascension - Slash twice 
 Immediately switch in Komamura and launch a slash together with Tengen Myo-oh, dealing 358.75% AoE DMG to the target and gaining 1 stack of Build Up. ~~Tenken Ascension - Charged Strike~~ Bankai State 
 Kokujo Tengen Myo-oh  consumes all stacks of Build Up to release a powerful slash. Each stack of Build Up consumed triggers an extra strike that deals DMG equal to 89.25% of Komamura's ATK. Releasing this skill removes Bankai state.
skills.name: Tenken Release - Slash

skills.description: Use Flash Step to avoid attacks right before they hit. Perfect Dodges inflict True Time Freeze for 1.5 seconds, during which Komamura gains 15% ASPD and 25% MSPD for 4 seconds. Cooldown: 15s.
skills.name: Flash Step
